title: The Ser7 of RNA Pol II-CTD influences the recruitment of Cdc73 for mRNA transcription.
authors: Gupta, Adity; Kumar, Ashutosh; Singh, Neha; Patel, Madhu; Studitsky, Vasily M; Zhang, Kam Y J; Akhtar, Md Sohail
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟和突变实验研究RNA Pol II CTD磷酸化与Cdc73蛋白的互作界面，属于广义蛋白-DNA/转录复合物互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究，但对象非典型TF-DNA体系。
abstract: The carboxyl terminal domain of the largest subunit of eukaryotic RNA polymerase II (RNAPII) consists of highly conserved tandem repeats of Tyr(1)Ser(2)Pro(3)Thr(4)Ser(5)Pro(6)Ser(7), referred as CTD. The CTD undergoes posttranslational modifications where the interplay of kinases imparts specific CTD phosphorylations, recognized by regulatory proteins that help in the mRNA transcription. Here, the Ser5 phosphorylation (Ser5P) remains high during the transcription initiation, followed by the Ser2P which peaks towards the termination and the Ser7P remains high throughout the transcription process. The Paf1 elongation complex (Paf1C) through its Cdc73 subunit is recruited to the phosphorylated CTD and play active role during different stages of mRNA transcription. We show that the CTD binding domain of Cdc73 is an independent folding unit which interacts with the hyper phosphorylated CTD. The 500 ns MD simulation studies further identified the binding interface and the pattern of CTD phosphorylation involved in the interaction with Cdc73. The possible key residues were mutated and the subsequent pull down analysis suggests that the phosphorylated Ser2, Ser5 and Ser7 of the tandem CTD heptads interact respectively with Arg310, Arg268 and Arg300 of Cdc73. Our finding provides new insight for Cdc73 function during mRNA transcription.
abstract_zh: 真核RNA聚合酶II（RNAPII）最大亚基的羧基末端结构域由高度保守的串联重复序列Tyr(1)Ser(2)Pro(3)Thr(4)Ser(5)Pro(6)Ser(7)组成，称为CTD。CTD经历翻译后修饰，其中激酶的相互作用赋予特定的CTD磷酸化，这些磷酸化被参与mRNA转录的调节蛋白识别。在此，Ser5磷酸化（Ser5P）在转录起始期间保持高水平，随后Ser2P在终止阶段达到峰值，而Ser7P在整个转录过程中保持高水平。Paf1延伸复合物（Paf1C）通过其Cdc73亚基被招募至磷酸化的CTD，并在mRNA转录的不同阶段发挥积极作用。我们表明，Cdc73的CTD结合结构域是一个独立的折叠单元，与高度磷酸化的CTD相互作用。500 ns的分子动力学（MD）模拟研究进一步确定了参与Cdc73相互作用的结合界面及CTD磷酸化模式。对可能的关键残基进行突变，随后的pull down分析表明，串联CTD七肽重复序列中的磷酸化Ser2、Ser5和Ser7分别与Cdc73的Arg310、Arg268和Arg300相互作用。我们的发现为Cdc73在mRNA转录中的功能提供了新见解。
